summary: WeRide Inc. filed a 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return disclosing share repurchases. On May 13, 2026, the company repurchased 720,000 ordinary shares on the Nasdaq at USD 2.4228 per share, representing 0.0759% of existing issued shares, now held as treasury shares. The board confirmed the repurchases were duly authorized and compliant with listing rules. No material premium or shareholder return program detail is provided. What to watch: continuation of buyback pace and potential cancellation of treasury shares.
